item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Thursday 26 February In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Thursday, 26 February - politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Weather Update Today: Delhi records 4°C above normal heat; Temperatures likely to climb further
item.description: The maximum temperature in Delhi has been recorded above normal and is expected to rise further in the coming days. Furthermore, the air quality index remains in the poor category, raising concerns about both heat and pollution.

item.title: Police vs Police: Delhi–Himachal police standoff ends after 24 hours
item.description: A serious dispute has erupted between the Delhi and Himachal Police over the arrest of three Youth Congress members. An FIR has been filed against the Delhi Police on charges of kidnapping; the conflict continues despite court intervention.

item.title: Gold-Silver Rate Today: Gold and Silver prices decline after recent gains; Global uncertainty keeps market volatile
item.description: Gold and silver prices fell on MCX due to profit booking after recent gains. However, ongoing geopolitical tensions, US tariff concerns, and dollar fluctuations are limiting losses, keeping the medium- to long-term outlook for precious metals cautiously optimistic.

item.title: Stock Market Rally: Sensex and Nifty Rise on IT Strength; Banking Stocks Pause
item.description: The Indian stock market saw gains on Thursday, led by gains in IT stocks. However, weakness in banking stocks limited the upside. Positive cues from Asian markets also boosted investor confidence.

item.title: Brazil floods kill 46, Dozens missing as heavy rains batter Minas Gerais
item.description: Severe floods triggered by relentless rainfall have killed at least 46 people in Brazil’s Minas Gerais state, with 21 still missing. Over 3,600 residents have been displaced as landslides and rising waters devastated towns including Juiz de Fora and Ubá.

item.title: Rashmika Mandanna, Vijay Deverakonda tie the knot today in dual ceremonies; Full royal wedding details inside
item.description: Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda are set to marry on February 26 in a traditional ceremony honoring both Telugu and Kodava customs. The wedding follows a unique “primal” theme focused on simplicity and cultural roots.

item.title: Supreme Court slams NCERT; CJI Surya Kant terms textbook chapter a ‘Deep-Rooted Conspiracy’ against Judiciary
item.description: The Supreme Court of India on Thursday heard a suo motu case over a Class 8 NCERT textbook chapter referring to corruption in the judiciary. Chief Justice Surya Kant termed it a “deep-rooted conspiracy” against the institution.

item.title: Avimukteshwaranand seeks anticipatory bail in POCSO case; Allahabad HC to hear plea tomorrow
item.description: The controversy began on 21 February, when an FIR was registered in Prayagraj following directions from a Special POCSO Court. Apart from Swami Avimukteshwaranand, his disciple Mukundanand Brahmachari and others have also been named in the complaint.

item.title: Train Passengers Take Note: Major Railway rule changes from 1 March; Full details here
item.description: From March 1, Indian Railways will discontinue the UTS app and introduce the new RailOne app for all ticketing services. Passengers can book general, platform, and reserved tickets on a single platform.
